'''Montserrat Vilà i Planella''' ([[Figueres]], 1964)<ref name="1:cawp">{{cite web |title=Montserrat Vilà, detective de plantas |url=http://www.casadelaciencia.csic.es/pages/montse.php |website=casadelaciencia.csic.es |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160129125245/http://www.casadelaciencia.csic.es/pages/montse.php |via=Internet Archive |access-date=20 February 2023 |archive-date=2016-01-29 |language=es}}</ref> is a Spanish [[ecology|ecologist]] who primarily studies the biological and environmental factors that determine the presence and success of [[Invasive species|invasive plants]], as well as their ecological and economic impacts.<ref name="2:cawp">{{cite web |title=Montserrat Vilà's home page |url=http://www.montsevila.org/index.php |website=www.montsevila.org |access-date=20 February 2023 |language=en}}</ref>

==Biography==
Vilà received a bachelor's degree in Sciences (Biology, 1988) from [[Autonomous University of Barcelona]] (UAB).
She did her doctorate at UAB's {{ill|Centre de Recerca Ecològica i Aplicacions Forestals|es}} (CREAF), under the direction of Dr. Jaume Terradas, and presented the thesis, "Effect of competition in Erica multiflora resprouting, growth and flowering after disturbances", in 1993. Between 1994 and 1996, she worked as a post-doctoral researcher at the [[University of California, Berkeley]]. Later, she worked as a research professor associated with CREAF and taught at the [[University of Barcelona]],<ref name="2:cawp" /> while maintaining a close link with UC Berkeley.<ref name="1:cawp" />

In 2006, Vilà began working at the {{lang|es|Estación Biológica de Doñana}}, where she has been a research professor since 2010 and deputy director from 2012 to 2015.<ref name="2:cawp" />
[[File:Montse en Chile.jpg|thumb|Montserrat Vilà (Chile, 2014)]]
In 2017 and 2018, she coordinated evaluations and follow-ups in the area of plant, animal, and ecology biology at the [[State Research Agency]]. From 2017, she is a member of the scientific committee for [[flora]] and [[fauna]] of the [[Ministry of Environment (Spain)|Ministry of Environment]].<ref name="muyinteresante">{{cite news |last1=Bayón |first1=Álvaro |title=Montserrat Vilà: una eminencia científica femenina en especies invasoras |url=https://www.muyinteresante.es/naturaleza/16145.html |access-date=20 February 2023 |work=Muy Interesante |date=8 February 2022 |language=es}}</ref>. She was also part of the [[Intergovernmental Science-Policy Platform on Biodiversity and Ecosystem Services|IPBES]] 10 assessment on invasive alien species and their control<ref>{{Cite journal |last=Bacher, S., Galil, B., Núñez, M., Ansong, M., Cassey, P., Dehnen‑Schmutz, K., Fayvush, G., Hiremath, A., Ikegami, M., Martinou, A., McDermott, S., Preda, C., Vila, M., Weyl, O. L. F., & Fernández, R. |date=2023 |title=Impacts of invasive alien species on nature, nature’s contributions to people, and good quality of life (Chapter 4). In IPBES Invasive Alien Species Assessment (pp. 1–222). |url=https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.7430731 |journal=IPBES |volume=10 |issue=1}}</ref>.

Vilà has published more than 170 scientific articles, co-edited seven books, and has written more than 40 book chapters.[4] In 2014 he was one of the 47 people of Spanish nationality chosen Highly cited researcher,<ref name="5:cawp">{{cite web |title=Highly Cited Researchers |url=https://clarivate.com/highly-cited-researchers/ |website=Clarivate |access-date=20 February 2023 |language=en}}</ref><ref name="6:cawp">{{cite web |title=47 españoles entran en la lista de los 3.000 investigadores más importantes del mundo |url=https://www.20minutos.es/noticia/2180034/0/47-espanoles/lista-3000-investigadores/mas-importantes-mundo/ |website=www.20minutos.es - Últimas Noticias |access-date=20 February 2023 |language=es |date=29 June 2014}}</ref> the Thomson Reuters agency list of the most cited scientists of the last 10 years. From 2014 to 2019, he has appeared every year in the Highly cited researchers list.<ref name="7:cawp">{{cite web |title=Archived Lists - HCR |url=https://hcr.clarivate.com/researchers-list/archived-lists/ |website=hcr.clarivate.com |via=web.archive.org |access-date=20 February 2023 |date=31 August 2018|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180831035429/https://hcr.clarivate.com/researchers-list/archived-lists/ |archive-date=2018-08-31 }}</ref><ref name="8:cawp">{{cite web |title=Josep Peñuelas apareix a la llista de científics més influents del món - Blog CREAF |url=https://blog.creaf.cat/noticies/josep-penuelas-apareix-a-la-llista-de-cientifics-mes-influents-del-mon/ |website=creaf.cat |access-date=20 February 2023 |language=ca |date=27 November 2017}}</ref><ref name="9:cawp">{{cite web |title=Highly Cited Researchers 2019 - Publicador de contenidos |url=http://www.ebd.csic.es/widget/inicio/-/asset_publisher/nyV5NR2PsU7H/content/highly-cited-researchers-2019/maximized |website=www.ebd.csic.es |access-date=20 February 2023}}</ref>

== Awards and honours ==
* 2019, Member of the Scientific Advisory Committee of Fundación Gadea Ciencia.
* 2020, Distinction in Ecology Luís Balaguer and honorary member of the Spanish Association of Terrestrial Ecology (AEET).
* 2020, North-South Prize from the Council of Europe to the Mediterranean Experts on Climate and Environmental Change (MedECC) network.
* 2021, Mercer Award from the [[Ecological Society of America]].
* 2021, Numerary member of the Real Academia Sevillana de Ciencias.
* 2021, {{ill|Premio Nacional de Investigación|es}} Alejandro Malaspina in the area of Science and Technology of Natural Resources.<ref name="3:eswp">{{cite web|url=https://www.ciencia.gob.es/Noticias/2021/Noviembre/El-Ministerio-de-Ciencia-e-Innovacion-otorga-las-diez-modalidades-de-los-Premios-Nacionales-de-Investigacion-2021.html|title=El Ministerio de Ciencia e Innovación otorga las diez modalidades de los Premios Nacionales de Investigación 2021|website=ciencia.gob.es|language=es}}</ref>
